summary: More 2.19 deprecations: STRING_TYPE_FILTERS, DEFAULT_JINJA2_EXTENSIONS, DEFAULT_MANAGED_STR, Display.get_deprecation_message, loading non-decodable files, first_found path splitting, auto_legacy interpreter options and invalid inventory variable names.
questions: How do I customize ansible_managed now that DEFAULT_MANAGED_STR is deprecated?
Can I enable Jinja2 extensions in ansible.cfg?
Should first_found paths be a comma-separated string?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.19 deprecations (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `STRING_TYPE_FILTERS`: no effect (native types always preserved).
- `DEFAULT_JINJA2_EXTENSIONS`: enabling Jinja2 extensions is deprecated; use filter, test and lookup plugins.
- `DEFAULT_MANAGED_STR`: deprecated; set the `ansible_managed` variable like any other variable.
- `Display.get_deprecation_message` → call `Display.deprecated` (with `removed=True` to raise).
- Loading text files that can't be decoded (usually UTF-8) is deprecated.
- `first_found`: splitting paths on `,;:` is deprecated; pass a list.
- `INTERPRETER_PYTHON`: `auto_legacy`/`auto_legacy_silent` → `auto`/`auto_silent`.
- Inventory plugins setting invalid variable names is deprecated.
